metadata_template.a_button_note: A is currently RELEASED. Selecting A_held creates a fresh press, which can start a jump only if Mario is on a surface.
metadata_template.rules_and_button_semantics: Play Super Mario Bros 1-1 alive to the flag toward the right. Use the actual screenshots to infer Mario, enemies, surfaces and motion. Game physics pauses while you decide. The selected complete button state is held for the whole declared interval. A starts a jump only on a NEW press while on a surface. Holding A during ascent increases height and airtime; releasing during ascent makes a shorter jump. Once descending, release A to prepare the next fresh press. Holding A through landing cannot start another jump. B runs faster and farther; momentum persists on release. Jump onto solid pipes/blocks/stairs or over gaps; time takeoff from the visible ground. Enemies hurt on side contact and can be stomped from above. Background hills/clouds are decorative. You choose all controls; no automatic correction exists.

a_button_notes.released: A is currently RELEASED. Selecting A_held creates a fresh press, which can start a jump only if Mario is on a surface.
a_button_notes.held: A is ALREADY HELD. Selecting A_held continues this SAME press; it cannot start a new jump after landing. Holding remains useful during ascent. Release A to enable a subsequent fresh press.
